title: Technical Leadership & Strategic Execution (Lead I)
exp: Lead I / Engineering Lead interviews test cross-team alignment, architectural RFCs, incident post-mortems, and mentoring frameworks.
pts: **Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) & RFC Process:** driving consensus across engineering teams without dictating.

qa.q: How do you handle an architectural stalemate between two senior engineers on your team?
qa.a:
**Elevator Pitch:** Focus the discussion on business requirements, measurable trade-offs (latency, cost, complexity), and operational maintenance. Have each engineer author a brief RFC with pros/cons/risks, prototype if needed, and make a decision aligned with team standards, documenting it in an ADR.
